goal: Design review: open every page with the Playwright browser tools at desktop and phone width, compare with docs/DESIGN.md, and fix templates, CSS and front-end scripts directly where they fall short.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every page matches docs/DESIGN.md at desktop and phone width

decisions.what: A tile head without an h2 but with a tool button (.ws-head:has(.btn)) is an in-flow, right-aligned, full-width row
decisions.why: The floating head put '3D view' over the map figure title at 375px; DESIGN.md says the 3D button has its own row
The round 4 .map-layout align-items:start (>=900px) shrank the map figure to 539 of 729px inside the flex tile

decisions.what: Selected point panel h2 is a 44px title row with 96px right padding
decisions.why: Keeps the panel text clear of the floating move and expand buttons, like figure captions

decisions.what: Mode bar button selector raised to .js-plotly-plot .plotly .modebar .modebar-btn
decisions.why: Plotly's injected 22px height rule beat the 28px rule from DESIGN.md Components at equal specificity

decisions.what: Recorded the review in DESIGN.md 'Changes this round' and corrected the map paragraph; no token change
decisions.why: DESIGN.md must say what the code does after a review

tried_and_failed.what: grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) on .ws-tile.map-layout to widen the map
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: The tile is display:flex (column), not grid; the shrink came from align-items:start

assumptions: test_AC_42 (5.13 s vs a 5 s limit) failed only because my screenshot sweep loaded the machine; it passed in the following full run
Date inputs report no outline on the input element itself because Chromium rings the inner segments (as ticket 476 recorded)

lessons.lesson: When a component's wrapper class is reused on a new element (e.g. .map-layout on a flex tile), check old media-query rules such as align-items:start; they can silently shrink children
lessons.when: Design review after a layout refactor into tiles
lessons.evidence: map figure 539px of a 729px tile at 1280

lessons.lesson: Measure Plotly modebar button heights in the browser: Plotly injects its own styles, and they win at equal specificity
lessons.when: Restyling Plotly chrome from a stylesheet

lessons.lesson: Do not run a Playwright sweep at the same time as the full suite: the speed test test_AC_42 fails under the extra load
lessons.when: Design review with a background suite
lessons.evidence: test_AC_42 5.13 s during the sweep, passed in the next run
